test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), httpx AsyncClient ASGI transport
build_command: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.in
test_command: cd apps/backend && eval "$(pyenv init -)" && pyenv shell 3.11.15 && python -m pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: Run pytest on the new test file: python -m pytest tests/test_pr358_chat_audit.py -v
setup_instructions: eval "$(pyenv init -)" && pyenv shell 3.11.15 && cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-env pytest-cov
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 via pyenv. No real AI services available - must use mocked providers. Tests use JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long and APP_ENV=test.
contribution_requirements: Tests follow existing patterns in tests/ directory. Use httpx.AsyncClient with ASGITransport for endpoint tests. Use unittest.mock for service mocking. pytest.ini sets asyncio_mode=auto.
key_patterns: conftest.py provides: client fixture (AsyncClient), mock_user, auth_headers. Tests mock rate_limit, Redis, MongoDB, search_service, LLM providers. SSE stream events use format: data: {"content": "...", "done": false}. Final event includes done=true, latency_ms, model, lang. ChatRequest model accepts: message, lang (Optional[en|as]), session_id, context_messages.
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app (api/v1/chat.py, services/chat_service.py, services/ai/router.py, services/ai/vertex_client.py, services/ai/sarvam_client.py, services/search/vertex_search.py, config.py), apps/backend/tests/ - pytest tests, apps/frontend/src/pages/ - React pages
